question.prompt: The normal vectors of two half-planes are \(n_1=(1,0,0)\) and \(n_2=(0,1,0)\). What is \(n_1\cdot n_2\)?

solutions.explanation:
The dot product is the sum of corresponding-coordinate products:
\[
n_1\cdot n_2=1\cdot0+0\cdot1+0\cdot0=0.
\]
Since both vectors are nonzero, the two normal vectors are perpendicular.
solutions.title: Coordinate dot product
